heroHeadline: Poland's Constitutional Tribunal Crisis Escalates as Nawrocki and Tusk Clash
heroSubtitle: After the Tribunal's president was suspended on 30 Oct, President Nawrocki entered the court, new judges were seated and riot police clashed with protesters. Separately, the suspect in the October plot against PM Tusk remains charged with nine offences; no foreign link has been reported.
footerNote: Data sourced from official Polish government statements, major international outlets, and institutional analyses.
